ruling: - **R21. A page write never asks.** Owner 19:01 CST Nov 10: "ive found repos in cloud sessions of triage of repos requesting for me to permit this when it should just always be allowed this needs to be fixed too". The card was "Allow Claude to use db write (claude-artifacts)?". Outcome: triage stalls on a card for an act that is always allowed, so the owner's answers wait. The hooks that judge a page write (call_judge.py, guard.py) still run, so no check is lost. 1. Read on main, 19:02 CST: `settings.json` already allows `mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write` and the other page tools. The cloud card shows anyway. Owner 19:13 CST, a second card in a Degen session: "even this artifact write needed my permission". That card names the tool as `claude-artifacts: db write`, the allowed name, so a missing name is not the whole cause. Suspects: that session's settings lack the entry, or the card comes from claude.ai and no settings file can lift it. Owner 19:15 CST, a third card (home triage restoring its page, 18 writes): "only allow once for these". The card offers no "always allow", which points at the second suspect. Owner chat in the retrospective session, 19:27 CST, on home triage reloading its page: "so the triage session pulled it off [agents] which sskrf for permission on every repopulate and instead did it in batches of like hundred each but each batch still need my approvsl". And: "thats still not optimal". The card shows once per call even with `db_write` allowed. That session also showed two tool names the allow list lacks: `mcp__claude-artifacts__db_usage` and `mcp__claude-artifacts__read_artifact`. Auto mode rightly refused its try to write its own allow list. 2. Until the fix lands, a page writer sends its writes in the main session, as `batch` calls of up to 50 writes each, one card per call. It never writes the page from an agent. 3. The page hooks match `ArtifactData` only, so they skip a write named `mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write`. Open PR #2549 (artifact-guard-matcher-names) adds those names. It lands with this fix. 4. Owner 19:04 CST: "claude also added new artifact commands that start with db (surf the web) that im guessing we need to add too now to the allow list". `ArtifactData` now has nine actions: get, list, query, profiles, set, update, str_replace, delete, batch. The allow list names six tools. A web search found no public list of the new tool names. 5. The fix lane first reproduces the card in a cloud session. It reads the real tool names from that session's tool listing, never from a guess. It then allows every page database action under each name the card checks. A test proves a page write in a cloud session shows no card.
